text: Closed with published DetectorMetamorphicLaws and MachineChunking. Laws cover exact event timing under joint translation and rotation, coherent spatial scaling of thresholds/centres/dispersion, coherent time scaling of timestamps/minimum duration, and arbitrary chunk boundaries with one final flush; every floating equivariance receives a named Tolerance. A fixed non-vacuous fixture has identical hard-coded JVM/JS summaries (two events at [0,12)ms and [17,30)ms), includes threshold-near spatial spread, and includes a short run that appears if duration scaling is wrong. Verification: lawsJVM/test 216/216; lawsJS/test 216/216; git diff --check passed. Four simultaneous mutants produced four named failures: dropped y translation, unscaled extent, unscaled minimum duration, and flush-at-every-chunk. All restored before the full green run.
